name: Shiori
message: "I think we've gone everywhere I wanted to, except for *that place*. It's gotten a little awkward to go there now, hasn't it?"

name: Shiori
message: "We could just go somewhere else instead, but it would definitely weigh on me..."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, time to work up the courage and go."
(Convenience store)

name: Shiori
message: "...She doesn't seem to be here."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm half relieved, and half disappointed."

name: Shiori
message: "I wasn't exactly calm yesterday... If possible, I wanted to talk to her again with a clearer head."

name: Shiori
message: "It's not like I expect us to understand each other or anything, but she did help us, right?"

name: Shiori
message: "At the very least, I wanted to thank her for that."

name: Shiori
message: "But if she's not here, there's nothing I can do... As Ms. Librarian would put it, perhaps our ties have already been severed."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, I need to move on. Not everything ends in a satisfying way."

name: Shiori
message: "Now then, could you print the photo?"
Time to head inside.

name: Shiori
message: "Welcome back."
(Hand over the photo)

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. Looks like this is my last death photo."

name: Shiori
message: "I've made you take so many of these, and even print them out, but just when I was about to apologize..."

name: Shiori
message: "I realized, this was your idea, wasn't it? Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "It might be a little twisted, but it's still a precious memory between you and me."

name: Shiori
message: "Shall we head to our usual park? I still have to write the final entry."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, time to start writing."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's take a seat."
(Sit down)

name: Shiori
message: "There we go... Hmm~, let's see... how should I start..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, this might take a while, so let's just talk while I write, okay?"

name: Shiori
message: "I used to come here with my sister every now and then."

name: Shiori
message: "I always thought this park was a bit too far for my sister, so we'd usually end up going to the one closer to home. But I think she actually liked this one better."

name: Shiori
message: "It's not like she ever said so outright... but whenever there were playground sets, she'd feel obligated to play with them."

name: Shiori
message: "Here, all you have to do is sit down and take it easy, so maybe she felt more at ease."

name: Shiori
message: "We'd secretly bring Mom's picture books and read them together, or just sit there doing nothing, talking about whatever came to mind..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, I keep talking about my sister, don't I? I was a lot older than she was, so I couldn't help doting on her."

name: Shiori
message: "I'd go on and on about her at school, and my friends would just roll their eyes."

name: Shiori
message: "Back then, I never even imagined that I'd end up dying."

name: Shiori
message: "Five long years, eh? Somehow, it just doesn't sink in."

name: Shiori
message: "Man, her elementary school entrance ceremony must've been ages ago, and in just a few more years... she'll be in middle school? Wow, guess it's really been that long."

name: Shiori
message: ".........Hmm, let's see... what else..."

name: Shiori
message: "...Ah, I got so focused on writing that I forgot to stay in character."

name: Shiori
message: "I was trying my best so you wouldn't be surprised if my tone suddenly changed... but eh, whatever. I'm tired. Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "It's kind of amazing that I managed to keep that up even after losing my memories... that elegant, theatrical version of Kugayama Shiori I used to play with my sister."

name: Shiori
message: "I couldn't even remember my sister's face or name, and yet I remembered something like that. In a way, that's very me."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, just a little bit longer. I'm almost done."

name: Shiori
message: "Right, lastly..."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah... that should do it. I think I've written everything I wanted to."

name: Shiori
message: "But before you read it..."

name: Shiori
message: "Hey, can you come here for a sec?"
(Stand up)

name: Shiori
message: "Yup, this way."

name: Shiori
message: "Uh... just a sec, my memory's kinda hazy. The first time we met was..."
"Here."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, right. It was over here."

name: Shiori
message: "It's this tree. The tree I hanged myself from."

name: Shiori
message: "I must've looked so suspicious, like something straight out of a horror movie... I'm surprised you didn't just run away on the spot."

name: Shiori
message: "But if you ignored me, I'd probably be still here, pointlessly killing myself again and again."

name: Shiori
message: "You know, I finally figured out why I kept killing myself."

name: Shiori
message: "Back then, I said maybe if I died one more time, I'd finally find peace, right?"

name: Shiori
message: "Before I met you, I was trapped by the words I heard just before I died, so I kept killing myself over and over."

name: Shiori
message: "Did I lose something precious because I failed to die?"

name: Shiori
message: "To me who was fading away, suicide was the same as questioning myself."

name: Shiori
message: "I'd keep asking myself whether I should've died."

name: Shiori
message: "But you know..."

name: Shiori
message: "Once I met you, things changed. It wasn't like that anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "Once I became myself again, my suicides weren't the same."

name: Shiori
message: "Remember what Ms. Librarian said? If I really meant to pass on, I would've disappeared the moment I killed myself."

name: Shiori
message: "In other words, I never really meant to pass on, and I never truly meant to die either."

name: Shiori
message: "All I really wanted to do was show you my fake deaths."

name: Shiori
message: "You know, I used to play hide-and-seek with my sister all the time at home."

name: Shiori
message: "Our apartment unit wasn't very big, so there weren't many places to hide, so I had to get creative with how I hid."

name: Shiori
message: "My sister was a strange kid. She loved seeing people die in horror movies."

name: Shiori
message: "I figured maybe she'd like it if I played dead, so I tried collapsing onto the floor on a whim."

name: Shiori
message: "But no... she start bawling and yelling, 'Onee-chan, nooo!'"

name: Shiori
message: "She clung to me and sobbed. She was so cute that every time we played hide-and-seek, I'd end up playing dead."

name: Shiori
message: "I kept changing it up so it wouldn't get repetitive, and before long my sister didn't even want to play hide-and-seek anymore..."

name: Shiori
message: "Dad would get mad and tell me to knock it off, and when I splattered ketchup on the floor, Mom scolded me for wasting food..."

name: Shiori
message: "It was probably a terrible memory for her, and a bittersweet one for me, but it's something I'll always hold dear."

name: Shiori
message: "It was the only time I was ever mean to my sister... Even when I forgot everything and nearly lost myself, it was the one memory that stayed with me. I'll always cherish it, now and forever."

name: Shiori
message: "The fact that you were the one who found me hanging here..."

name: Shiori
message: "We must've been tied by fate, as Ms. Librarian would put it."

name: Shiori
message: "Up until today, I've been playing dead every single day, waiting for you."

name: Shiori
message: "Waiting for you to find me."

name: Shiori
message: "Could you take off your hat?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... I knew it."

name: Shiori
message: "The reason you never told me your name... wasn't because you didn't want to get cursed."

name: Shiori
message: "I knew who you were."

name: Shiori
message: "I've known for a very long time."

name: Shiori
message: "You've grown so much, Shiika."
"Long time no see."
"Onee-chan."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, it's been so long."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm so sorry... for forgetting you, Shiika..."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you so much for staying by my side, waiting so patiently until my memories came back."
"I just wanted to stay with you..."
"For as long as I could..."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah."
"I was afraid you'd ask..."
"'Who are you?'"

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, that makes sense... I didn't remember you, after all... I'm sorry."

name: Shiori
message: "All this time, I thought you were a boy."

name: Shiori
message: "At your age, it's hard to tell just from your voice, and you dressed like one too..."

name: Shiori
message: "I guess I'm just making excuses. I'm sorry I didn't realize sooner."
"Mom wanted me to..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... did she tell you to pretend to be a boy when you're out?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, that makes sense. You almost got kidnapped, after all. Mom must be worried."

name: Shiori
message: "It's okay. Once you're a little older, I'm sure she'll let you wear cute clothes."

name: Shiori
message: "But your outfit right now already suits you. It really does."

name: Shiori
message: "...How are Mom and Dad? Are they doing okay?"
"They're doing okay, but..."
"They seem lonely."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh... So they still haven't forgotten about me."

name: Shiori
message: "Where did you move to? I always kept you out pretty late. Did that cause you any trouble?"
"It's not that far."
"So it's okay."

name: Shiori
message: "That's good. But you should still be careful, okay? Make sure you stick to well-lit streets on your way home—"

name: Shiori
message: "...Never mind. I'm sure Mom's told you a thousand times by now."

name: Shiori
message: "It's kind of surreal... talking to you like this, now that you're older."

name: Shiori
message: "That day... five years ago, when you were almost kidnapped..."

name: Shiori
message: "That man stabbed me, and I died."

name: Shiori
message: "But I never knew if I managed to save you."

name: Shiori
message: "That's why... I'm so glad..."

name: Shiori
message: "You've grown up so much."

name: Shiori
message: "So I really did save you."

name: Shiori
message: "Looks like I don't have any regrets left."

name: Shiori
message: "...I wish I could act like a cool big sister and leave it at that, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "I wish I could've stayed with you longer."

name: Shiori
message: "I wish I could've watched you grow up."

name: Shiori
message: "I wish I could've cried at your wedding. I wish I could've held your children in my arms."

name: Shiori
message: "I wish... I could've lived longer."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm just overflowing with regrets. Lame, aren't I?"
"That's not true."

name: Shiori
message: "Really? Ehehe, thanks."

name: Shiori
message: "I have so many regrets, too many to count."

name: Shiori
message: "But... maybe God granted me a small mercy."

name: Shiori
message: "A short detour before I make my way to heaven."

name: Shiori
message: "I got to see you all grown up, Shiika."

name: Shiori
message: "I got to talk with you so much, Shiika."

name: Shiori
message: "I got to take walks with you again, just like we used to, Shiika."

name: Shiori
message: "We got to investigate that case, talk to all the other ghosts, and even try out urban legends together..."

name: Shiori
message: "It was fun. It was really, really fun."

name: Shiori
message: "God gave me a final chance to make even more memories with you, Shiika."

name: Shiori
message: "But honestly, I still want to stay by your side and make countless more memories, Shiika."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah."

name: Shiori
message: "I guess your big sis' little detour ends here."

name: Shiori
message: "Here, it's yours."

name: Shiori
message: "Our memories, along with my feelings."

name: Shiori
message: "Be sure to read it later, okay? It's a promise."
(Accept the Death Diary)
(Don't Accept the Death Diary)

name: Shiori
message: "Take good care of it, okay?"

name: Shiori
message: "Also, there's actually one more favor I want to ask you..."

name: Shiori
message: "Please, Shiika."
(Accept the Death Diary)

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "Also, there's just one last thing I'd like to ask of you..."

name: Shiori
message: "Can we take a picture together?"

name: Shiori
message: "Come to think of it, we never took one. What do you think?"
"Let's."

name: Shiori
message: "Yay, let's do it, then!"

name: Shiori
message: "Come on, closer. Stop being shy."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, perfect. Whenever you're ready."
(Take a photo)

name: Shiori
message: "Wow, it came out so nice. A commemorative photo with a ghost, now that's priceless. Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "I'd love it if you printed that one too and added it to the diary."

name: Shiori
message: "And I'd really love it if it reminded you of me every once in a while."

name: Shiori
message: "...Alright. Now I really don't have any regrets left!"

name: Shiori
message: "Actually... I guess I still do. I wish I could've stayed with you longer..."

name: Shiori
message: "If I really wanted to... I probably could, like Ms. Librarian."

name: Shiori
message: "But... I don't think it's right for someone who's dead to linger at your side."

name: Shiori
message: "One day, my love for you could turn into fixation, which would eventually become a curse."

name: Shiori
message: "Ghosts don't have much self control. I learned that the hard way."

name: Shiori
message: "So before that happens... before I start going crazy..."

name: Shiori
message: "I want to say goodbye while I'm still myself, the big sister you know."

name: Shiori
message: "You're kind of a goofball like dad and me, so I do worry..."

name: Shiori
message: "But I know you'll do just fine without me now. You're already growing into a wonderful young woman."

name: Shiori
message: "That said, if something ever happens, don't be afraid to lean on someone, okay?"

name: Shiori
message: "You're responsible, just like Mom, so I know you'll be alright."

name: Shiori
message: "...Yeah, you'll be okay. Even without me, you'll be just fine."

name: Shiori
message: "That said, if you ever run into trouble, don't be afraid to lean on someone, okay?"
"Yeah."

name: Shiori
message: "Take care of yourself, okay?"
"Yeah."

name: Shiori
message: "Stay away from dangerous places."
"Yeah."

name: Shiori
message: "And don't go trying out urban legends on a whim."
"Yeah."

name: Shiori
message: "And also..."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay."

name: Shiori
message: "It's time for your big sis..."

name: Shiori
message: "...to go."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you for finding me, Shiika."

name: Shiori
message: "Because of you, I was able to make one last batch of happy memories. It's now the greatest treasure of my life."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you, Shiika."

name: Shiori
message: "Take care."
"Onee-chan."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah?"
"Thank you for saving me."
"See you again!"

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah. I'll be waiting in heaven!"

name: Shiori
message: "Goodbye for now, Shiika!"
Onee-chan's gone.
She's gone from this world.
...I don't want to go home yet.
I should go and tell everyone who helped us what happened...
"Want to come with me?"
She nodded... I think?
Time to go.
Ms. Librarian isn't here.
I'll leave a note.
That should do it.
Oh...
I can't see her anymore...
(Bow in gratitude)
Time to go.
